changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetDataProfile') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [RowCount] [int] NULL, [Uniqueness] [decimal](22, 4) NULL, [UniqueCount] [int] NULL, [Completeness] [decimal](22, 4) NULL, [NullCount] [int] NULL, [BlankCount] [int] NULL, [DataType] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [MinimumValue] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [MaximumValue] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [Precision] [int] NULL, [Scale] [int] NULL, [Average] [decimal](22, 4) NULL, [Median] [decimal](22, 4) NULL, [StandardDeviation] [decimal](28, 4) NULL, [Top10Values] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [ProcessIdentifier] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDataProfile_ID] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_AssetDataprofile_AssetID') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetDataprofile_AssetID] FOREIGN KEY([AssetID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Asset] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetDataprofile_AssetID] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID] ON [dbo].[AssetDataProfile] ( [AssetID] ASC ) END
